title: A resolved human review reaches the responsible session
when: After a human resolves a QA evidence review outside a deployment run.
need: The current item claim holder receives the requirement, outcome, reviewer note and next step. A missing holder routes to steering for staffing; queued messages remain in its undelivered view. If no session is addressable, resolution reports manual staffing while preserving the verdict. Deployment reviews retain their run/stage recipients.
surface: Session verdict notice; steering undelivered messages; QA requirement detail
review: Source and regression coverage; live delivery remains unverified until release.
